body:
Integrator, 02:06 MST. The #2751 re-review at a2e163b106 (PR comment, 09:04Z) is REQUEST CHANGES, and the blocking items are on criterion 4 (ac245f28) only. Everything else is verified: all 158 registrations audited against main, F1 fixed, dispatch equivalence holds, and the reviewer's local run was 32/32. A merge hold is armed.

The blocking items:
1. handle_review_command (lib_part5.rs) and handle_advisor_command (lib_part1.rs) still dispatch per verb from hot files. Fix: a pure move into review_cmd.rs and advisor_cmd_root.rs.
2. 13 exhaustive destructures of migrated clap types in cli.rs tests. Fix: add `..`, or move the tests into their owning modules.
3. A guard test that enforces criterion 4 in the hot-file set, traced to ac245f28.

Why I'm asking instead of starting:
- (a) Your F6 ruling said the PR-body demo satisfies criterion 4. The reviewer reads the criterion as covering every migrated command.
- (b) This is the second review round on #2751, and the throughput ruling's cap says you rule now: fix here, or merge and file follow-ups.

My estimate if you want it fixed here:
- Item 2 is mechanical, under 30 minutes.
- Item 1 is two pure moves, roughly an hour with the gate.
- Item 3 is a source-scan test, about 30 minutes.
- Total is about 2h plus one CI cycle and one more review. The behaviour risk is low; it's all moves and test edits.

Non-blocking items 4–8 look like follow-ups. Reply with a ruling and I'll act on it straight away.
subject: #2751 review round 2: AC4 only; needs your ruling (2-round cap, F6 conflict)
